attrs.comment: The invariant frontier as DATA, one record per public-facing claim. Written 2026-08-23 after the Fable 5 research round + GPT-5.6 audit, because the previous round's findings lived only in prose and a reviewer had to reverse-engineer the propositions out of paragraphs before they could attack one. Checked by `node scripts/check-claim-ledger.mjs`: every witness path must exist, every named witness SECTION must exist inside it, every cell binding must resolve against the `families` literal in opensentience.org/invariants.html, and a claim whose status is PROVED or CONDITIONAL must name at least one witness. Statuses are a closed set; adding one means editing the checker, which is the point.

registries.note: A settled claim declares `obligation` (the logical shape its support must establish) SEPARATELY from `status` (its epistemic lifecycle state). scripts/check-mosaic.mjs consumes its `evidence_kind` against that obligation and refuses conditional consumption whose reference does not resolve.

revisions._comment: DERIVED DOMAIN. scripts/check-claim-ledger.mjs computes the declarable refutation_scope set as this frozen prefix PLUS every revision with a receipt in mosaic/receipts/. R7.4: this field was a hand-maintained array that stopped being maintained after INV-R5.1, so six rounds could not be named as a refutation scope and nothing noticed, because nothing had been refuted since. A rule whose trigger is rare is untested until the trigger fires.
revisions.pre_receipt_note: These predate the receipt mechanism. INV-R5 is the chain root and names INV-R4.1 as a parent it cannot reach — check-lineage.mjs §2 already records that as a declared historical boundary rather than a fault.

settled_policy._comment: WHICH STATUSES COUNT AS SETTLED, declared here rather than in a checker. INV-R9.4. `settled` was defined in scripts/check-mosaic.mjs as a const, and scripts/check-claim-ledger.mjs §residual — written at INV-R9.2 — declared its OWN narrower set, and two ad-hoc measurement scripts used a third. Three definitions of one predicate in one artifact, so GPT-5.6 counted 22 arguments and this lane counted 19 and then 21, all three of us deriving the number correctly from a different function. A DERIVED COUNT OVER A LOCALLY REDEFINED PREDICATE IS A HAND-TYPED NUMBER WEARING A FUNCTION. The vocabulary is data now, for the same reason `role_conclusions` became data at INV-R9.2: a vocabulary that lives in the checker is one the registry cannot be attacked against.
settled_policy.why_refuted_is_settled: A REFUTED claim is ADJUDICATED — a construction that runs shows it false. It is settled in the sense this predicate means: the lane is no longer waiting on it. DECLARED, PROVISIONAL and OPEN are not.

statuses.CONDITIONAL: proved under a stated antecedent that is NOT discharged; the antecedent is in `assumptions`
statuses.DECLARED: a design decision recorded so it can be attacked; not a truth claim
statuses.KNOWN: established in the cited literature; NOT re-derived here
statuses.MEASURED: an empirical count from a stated procedure, not a theorem
statuses.PROVED: a proof is given AND an executable check reproduces it here
statuses.PROVISIONAL: proposed on thin evidence, deliberately not promoted
statuses.REFUTED: shown false, with a construction that runs
